authority: posthoc retrospective diagnostic only; all outcomes are known

A_event_specialist_rerank.specialist_training_rows: fresh_classified_economic_any=1 only, dates strictly before score month
A_event_specialist_rerank.policy: within daily baseline top50, take highest specialist-probability fresh event if probability>=0.50; replace rank2 only; never replace rank1; no replacement if already top2

B_capital_monotonic_rerank.policy: within baseline top50 add +0.05 baseline percentile for positive-only and -0.05 for negative-only, then select top2

B_capital_dilution_cash_veto.policy: if a baseline top2 slot has fresh_equity=1 and neither fresh_buyback nor fresh_share_cancellation, leave that 50% sleeve in cash; do not backfill rank3

C_fresh_low_runup_rerank.policy: within baseline top50 add +0.05 baseline percentile when fresh economic and xrank 20-day close momentum<=-0.5; subtract 0.05 when fresh economic and momentum>=+0.5; otherwise zero; select top2

C_fresh_high_runup_cash_veto.policy: if a baseline top2 slot has fresh economic and xrank 20-day close momentum>=+0.5, leave that 50% sleeve in cash; do not backfill rank3

known_limits: Every outcome is already known; temporal folds do not create promotion authority.
TDnet data contains title and timestamp only, not PDF body values or transaction magnitude.
No historical 08:58 board, indicative open, PTS, exact futures, volume or turnover is available.
The five recipes were fixed after diagnosing generation-1 results and before generation-2 outcome computation.
